&FlowMultiTagRowRequest; declare @p char(6), @r nvarchar(4000), @q nvarchar(4000)
select top 0 tr.id, a.dvt, a.loai, a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tl_ck, a.tk_ck, a.ma_thue, a.thue_suat, a.tk_thue, a.ma_kh2, c.tk_cn &FlowMultiUserDefinedFieldsQuery; into #d from #tagRow tr, d21$000000 a, dmtk c
set @r = ' insert into #d select tr.id, rtrim(a.dvt), rtrim(a.loai), a.so_luong, a.gia_nt, a.tl_ck, rtrim(a.tk_ck), rtrim(a.ma_thue), a.thue_suat, rtrim(a.tk_thue), rtrim(a.ma_kh2), isnull(c.tk_cn, 0) &FlowMultiUserDefinedFieldsQuery; from (select id, stt_rec, stt_rec0 from #tagRow where p = ''%Partition'') tr join d21$%Partition a on tr.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and tr.stt_rec0 = a.stt_rec0 left join dmtk c on a.tk_thue = c.tk '
select distinct p into #p from #tagRow select @p = min(p) from #p while @p is not null begin set @q = replace(@r, '%Partition', @p) exec sp_executesql @q select @p = min(p) from #p where p > @p end
select '' as array$, id, &OtherCopyField; from #d &FlowMultiOrderBy; return
